indicator("V49 contains-input-pattern-active")
sourceText = "abXab"
patternText = input.string("ab", "Pattern")
value = str.contains(source=sourceText, str=patternText)
consumer = input.bool(true, "Consumer", active=value)
plot(consumer ? 1 : 0, "CONSUMER")
plot(value ? 1 : 0, "TARGET")
plot(bar_index, "INDEX")
plot(close, "CONTROL_CLOSE")
